partner_result.application: Near-rank-one magnitudes with one frustrated triangle give ||p_Q||inf <= 6 sqrt(pi)/(1-8 delta), hence <11.344 for delta<=1/128.

new_result.statement: The three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis plus unit positive physical diagonals, PSD physical pairs, balanced triangle signs, and arbitrarily small pair defects does not force any fixed-size original-coordinate block or cross block to have a second singular value bounded below by a universal positive constant.
new_result.family: A=(1-2 delta)J+delta vv^T-delta uu^T+2delta I with balanced orthogonal sign vectors u,v and delta=n^(-1/2).
new_result.scope: Counterexample to fixed-size packet extraction only; not a counterexample to QFORM.

next_step: Exploit the four independent original-coordinate sign banks before reciprocal-minor payment; a valid bound must remain uniform for delta=n^(-1/2).
